notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 52-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.46, bnp 1912, creatinine 0.79, hemoglobin 12.9, platelets 242, sodium 138, wbc 7.5; vitals dbp 69-73, heart_rate 79-83, map 91-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 132-138, spo2 96-97, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: pulmonary vascular congestion, small bilateral effusions; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 40 mg IV; Transthoracic echo: LVEF 29%, global hypokinesis
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.78, hemoglobin 12.9, platelets 243, sodium 138, wbc 7.3; vitals dbp 69-73, heart_rate 80-85, map 91-94, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 133-137, spo2 96-97, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 40 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 52-year-old female, length of stay 5 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
